content.comment_body: Hello! We want to migrate a program from an older [product_name] [article_no] to [product_name] [version_no] software. Our goal is to modify the program and then transfer it to newer modules with type [article_no]. Is this approach supported? Specifically: Can the [version_no] software connect to the older modules to read their data? Is there still an official connector cable available for USB to [article_no]? Thanks!

Yes, it's possible to download the program from an old [article_no] using a USB cable and [product_name] [version_no] software. In the transfer window, choose 'cable' as the interface and pick the correct COM port, for example COM6. After downloading, make sure to select the new device model in the device options.
Thanks for the quick reply! I'll try your suggestion soon and will update with the outcome.
Update: your instructions were successful! The biggest challenge was removing the protection plates from the module ports. Appreciate the helpful advice.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants confirmed the possibility of transferring a program from an older [product_name] module to a newer one using [product_name] [version_no] and an appropriate USB cable. The process works as intended, though manual handling of hardware protection plates on ports can be a minor issue.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] [version_no] to support both old and new modules for seamless program transfer and edits, and are seeking confirmation regarding USB cable compatibility.
